source: NOAA ISD-lite hourly (10:00-22:00 local; evening 18:00-23:00) and GSOD daily on scheduled Cricsheet match days, via beating/cricket/weather.py climatology(); venue-months shrunk toward country, region and global month values

fields.dew_depression_evening: mean temperature minus dew point 18:00-23:00, C
fields.precip_mm: mean precipitation per match day, mm
fields.rain_day_freq: share of match days with >= 1 mm (rain flag where the amount is unknown)
fields.level: what the value rests on: venue_month, venue (other months plus country seasonality), country, region, global
